Name: MAP_GD_REGION_DRAW_PARAM
Description: Per-region irradiance volume bake setting; row ID is a MapGdRegionInfoParam Region ID. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Irradiance Volume Local Light Scale Override
Fields.Description: Scale for local (SFX) lights when the irradiance volume is baked; 0 or less: no override. Appears unused by the game. Retail: -1 on every row.
